title: 16th Sitting of first session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/16/1/2026).

Motion under Rule 201 of the Standing Orders by Kendhoo MP Mauroof Zakir for a debate on the steps the government could take to help tourism businesses in the Maldives overcome difficulties caused by the war in the Middle East.

First reading of the resolution by Holhudhoo MP Abdul Sattar Mohamed calling for a stop to unlawful activities by some political parties that breach the Constitution and the Political Parties Act, and for legal action against them.
Preliminary debate on the resolution by Holhudhoo MP Abdul Sattar Mohamed calling for a stop to unlawful activities by some political parties and for legal action against them.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was set to debate how the government could support tourism businesses hit by the Middle East war, and to introduce and debate a resolution against unlawful political-party activities.
